import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import bootstrap

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/requirements_engineering_for_ML-enabled_systems.csv')

# Filter the relevant columns for documentation methods
documentation_columns = [
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Not_Documented',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Vision_Document',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Requirements_Lists',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Goal_Models',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Use_Case_Models',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Prototypes',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_User_Stories',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_BDD_Scenarios',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_MLCanvas',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Notebooks',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Data_Models',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Others'
]

# Convert the documentation methods to numeric values (assuming they are on a scale from 1 to 5)
for col in documentation_columns:
    df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows with missing values
df = df.dropna(subset=documentation_columns)

# Calculate the mean for each documentation method
mean_values = df[documentation_columns].mean()

# Bootstrapping for statistical significance
bootstrap_result = bootstrap((df[documentation_columns].values,), np.mean, confidence_level=0.95)

# Identify the most frequently used documentation method
most_frequent_method = mean_values.idxmax()
most_frequent_value = mean_values.max()

# Print the results
most_frequent_method, most_frequent_value, bootstrap_result

import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/requirements_engineering_for_ML-enabled_systems.csv')

# Filter the relevant columns for documentation methods
documentation_columns = [
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Not_Documented',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Vision_Document',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Requirements_Lists',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Goal_Models',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Use_Case_Models',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Prototypes',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_User_Stories',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_BDD_Scenarios',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_MLCanvas',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Notebooks',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Data_Models',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Others'
]

# Convert the documentation methods to categorical values
for col in documentation_columns:
    df[col] = df[col].astype('category')

# Count the frequency of each documentation method
frequency_counts = df[documentation_columns].value_counts()

# Identify the most frequently used documentation method
most_frequent_method = frequency_counts.idxmax()
most_frequent_count = frequency_counts.max()

# Perform a chi-squared test for statistical significance
chi2, p, dof, expected = chi2_contingency(df[documentation_columns].value_counts().unstack())

# Print the results
most_frequent_method, most_frequent_count, chi2, p
